📺 Ringer (2011–2012)

Ringer follows Bridget Kelly, a troubled woman trying to escape her dangerous past after witnessing a murder. Hoping for a fresh start, she reconnects with her wealthy identical twin sister, Siobhan, whose seemingly perfect life hides dark secrets. When Siobhan mysteriously disappears, Bridget assumes her identity, believing it will protect her from the people pursuing her. However, she soon discovers that her sister’s glamorous world is filled with lies, betrayal, complicated relationships, and dangerous enemies. As Bridget struggles to maintain her disguise, she becomes trapped in a web of deception where every secret threatens to expose her true identity. Starring Sarah Michelle Gellar in a dual role, Ringer combines suspense, unexpected twists, and psychological drama while exploring identity, family, revenge, and the consequences of living someone else’s life.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Mystery • Thriller • Crime

⭐ IMDb: 6.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Eric Charmelo & Nicole Snyder

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and other digital platforms for current availability. Availability varies by region.
